snippet.title: Gallipoli - Siege of Kut Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Gallipoli is a new authentic FPS game set on the Ottoman Fronts of WW1! Dash across no man's land and through the palm trees to attack the town of Kut Al Amara – one of the maps coming to Gallipoli at launch.

Gallipoli releases in 2026 on Steam, PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, Microsoft PC and Epic Games Store. Please support the release by adding the game to your wishlist!

Wishlist now on: 
Steam: https://r.ww1gameseries.com/?13GallipSteamKutTrailer
PlayStation: https://r.ww1gameseries.com/?13GallipPSKutTrailer
Xbox: https://r.ww1gameseries.com/?13GallipXboxKutTrailer
Epic Games Store: https://r.ww1gameseries.com/?13GallipEpicKutTrailer

Read more about the Kut Al Amara map coming to Gallipoli: 
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3065940/view/532124583945306250
Reddit: https://www.reddit.com/r/WW1GameSeries/comments/1rfkhkx/gallipoli_kut_al_amara_trailer_introduction/

Also, don't forget to like and subscribe to our YouTube channel!
